Cue: acme release notes fails with E42
Text: Add the --since-tag none argument to the command to avoid the error.

Failed:
```
error: E42
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme release notes --since-tag none"}
```

Cue: Missing required database configuration in migrate script
Text: Always include the --db flag with the appropriate connection string when calling the migrate script.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db"}
```
